text: 尽管家庭能源账单大幅上涨，但英国经济在7月再次实现强劲增长，表现远超预期，各领域经济活动保持稳健。英国国家统计局周五公布，继6月增长0.3%之后，7月国内生产总值(GDP)增长了0.4%。这一结果远超分析师预期的持平。数据表明，经济增长已连续第三个月好于经济学家预期，暗示英国可能打破市场对其在2026年下半年大幅放缓的预期。当月服务业活动增长0.4%，工业生产增长0.2%，建筑业产出增长0.1%。
text_en: Despite a sharp rise in household energy bills, the UK economy again achieved strong growth in July, performing far better than expected, with activity remaining robust across sectors. The Office for National Statistics said Friday that GDP grew 0.4% in July, following 0.3% growth in June. That far exceeded analysts' expectations of flat growth. The data indicate that economic growth has beaten economists' forecasts for a third consecutive month, suggesting the UK may defy market expectations of a sharp slowdown in the second half of 2026. Services activity rose 0.4% in the month, industrial production grew 0.2%, and construction output rose 0.1%.
